name: audioclean
description: Audio enhancement with FFmpeg: FFT denoise (afftdn) and/or EBU R128 loudness normalization (loudnorm) into data/clean/<name>.clean.wav. Originals untouched, output duration measured via ffprobe, ffmpeg errors shown verbatim.
route: clean up the audio in D:/rec.wav, denoise D:/call.mp3, normalize the loudness of D:/x.wav, clean up and normalize D:/talk.wav
